content.name: Heightened Spell
entries: When you cast a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw to resist its effects, you can spend 3 sorcery points to give one target of the spell disadvantage on its first saving throw made against the spell.

content.name: Heightened Spell
entries: When you cast a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw, you can spend 2 Sorcery Points to give one target of the spell {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on saves against the spell.
